dct_title_s: CIRCULUS SAXONIAE INFERIORIS in omnes suos STATUS et PRINCIPATUS accurate divisus / ex conatibus IOH. BAPT. HOMANNI NORIMBERGAE. Cum Privilegio SAC. CAES. MAJESTATIS.
dct_description_sm: Publication details from Tooley's Dicitionary of Mapmakers E-J. Homann became geographer to the Holy Roman Emperor in 1715.; Relief shown pictorially.; Shows title in decorative cartouche at lower right, incorporating scale bars in "Milliaria Germ communia" and "Mill Gallica sive Horae itineris."; Printed from one of two plates used to produce this map? Compare an example printed from a different plate held by the Bibliothèque nationale de France (see http://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/btv1b5904861b - Collection d'Anville 03837) which includes an inset view of Hamburg at lower left.; Compare an example of the map published by Homann's hiers within an atlas but lacking the privilege - see Maps 4. TAB. 32.; Titled "Circulus Saxoniae Inferioris, auctore I.B. Homanno" in the Catalogue of Maps, Prints, Drawings, etc., forming the geographical and topographical collection attached to the Library of his late Majesty King George the third, etc., London, 1829.
1 map : copperplate engraving, hand colour 46 x 54 cm
dct_subject_sm: Lower Saxony (Germany) Maps Early works to 1800.
